description: 12th Ave S Bicycle Counter is a dataset listed in City of Seattle open data portal (cos-data.seattle.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Seattle. The 12th Ave S bicycle counter came to service early 2025 and records the number of bikes that cross the bridge using the bicycle pathways just south of S Lane St. Inductive loops on the east and west pathways count the passing of bicycles regardless of travel direction. Coverage: Seattle. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bike counts, 12th ave s, bike, bicycle, counts. The table has 4 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-cos-data-seattle-gov-portal.
